findings.documented: The listings endpoint documentation reports a total of 4110 records.
findings.actual: Fully paginating the endpoint without filters returned 4400 records; offset 4399 returned a record and offset 4400 returned an empty page.
findings.how_found: Drained /v1/listings page by page until an empty page was returned, then compared the retrieved count with the documented total.
findings.impact: Relying on the documented total would omit 290 retrievable listing records and produce incorrect downstream aggregate results.

findings.documented: Projects contain a total_listings field representing the reported number of listings for each project.
findings.actual: For 363 projects, total_listings differs from the actual number of retrievable /v1/listings records having the same project_id.
findings.how_found: Grouped all 4400 retrievable listing records by project_id and compared those counts with the total_listings value for each project.
findings.impact: The reported project-level listing counts cannot be assumed to match the retrievable listing records.
